summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by British American Tobacco p.l.c., a foreign private issuer, reporting transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities under a Share Incentive Plan. The filing discloses purchases of ordinary shares by the CEO and CMO at a price of 44.11809 per share under the Partnership Share Scheme. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or management change is involved. The filing is purely regulatory disclosure of insider share transactions and does not constitute a special situation.
